project.title: Response of butyrate-oxidizing microbial community to the co-effects of antibiotics and activated carbon
project.description: a mesophilic chemostat fed with butyrate as the sole carbon source was constructed. 16S rRNA high-throughput sequencing was employed to investigate the dynamic changes of butyrate-degrading microbial community under inhibition of Chlortetracycline (CTC) and co-effects of CTC and GAC, and explore the interactions between microorganisms and their response to inhibition of CTC and co-effects of CTC and GAC.

samples: Metagenome or environmental sample from sludge metagenome
environmental sample; urban association not established
